visualComparisons.observation: Uniform bodies occupy both halves with separated upper-left and lower-left groups. Moving bodies form a central vertical branching arrangement with a large right-side gap and mostly empty far-left region.

Moving bodies form a right-middle vertical cluster and bottom-edge groups, with a large empty left-middle region. Uniform has an occupied central-left chain and several top-right groups, so the occupied arrangement and gaps differ.

Moving bodies form a diagonal upper-right chain, a dense top-right edge group and substantial bottom-right edge occupancy. Uniform retains central-left and lower-left groups, a separate upper-right vertical chain, and a mostly empty bottom-right corner.

lateWithinMoving.observation: The moving right-middle vertical chain at2500 becomes a diagonal connection higher in the world by3000. The top-middle group clears as top-right edge occupancy grows; the bottom-center grouping thins and new dense bodies occupy the bottom-right corner. These are location and gap changes, not only colors.
